domains.name: Install and Set-Up
objectives: Explain the installation and set-up process and steps.

domains.name: Procurement Case Management
objectives: Describe how to use the Procurement Case Management Application and Advanced Work Assignment to resolve procurement issues.

domains.name: Procurement Operations
objectives: Explain how to utilize the Shopping Hub to optimize procurement operations.
Explain the sourcing and purchasing automations application and primary data set-up.

domains.name: Sourcing Operations
objectives: Explain how the Sourcing Operations Workflow is used to manage sourcing requests.
Describe the implementation of off-catalog record producers and Source-to-Pay Workspace for non-standard procurement requests.

domains.name: Approvals and Workflow Automation
objectives: Describe the approval rules and groups in procurement processes.
Describe the implementation of decision tables, system templates, and SLAs to streamline and automate procurement workflows and processes.
Describe the implementation of role-based access and dashboard features for procurement analytics.

domains.name: Integrations
objectives: Explain how the Source-to-Pay Integration Framework is used to streamline procurement operations.
Describe the integration of Sourcing and Procurement (SPO) with Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) and Contract Management Pro (CMP).
